summary: Ozone Pulse is a web platform that uses NASA data to visualize tropospheric column ozone trends over the surface of the earth, helping users compare cities and explore changes in the atmosphere.
details:
Ozone Pulse is a global web platform that helps users explore NASA ozone data through interactive graphs, trend analysis, and an inbuilt chatbot.

  • How it works: Processes ozone data and presents patterns across selected locations and periods. The chatbot helps users understand the information.
  • Benefits and impact: Makes atmospheric science more accessible, supporting environmental awareness, education, and research.
  • Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, NASA datasets, GitHub, and web hosting.
  • Creativity: Combines global ozone visualization with conversational assistance in one platform.
  • Team considerations: Data accuracy, usability, global coverage, and clear explanations of the difference between column ozone and ground-level pollution.
